C06 assessed baseline `main@2b1e404`. Three confirmed findings were accepted; their fixes are supported by implementation and project evidence.

rows: F1 — reservation created with a spoofed studentId
ACCEPTED
The controller passes the authenticated user. ReservationService requires the STUDENT role and derives ownership from the authenticated identity; studentId is no longer part of the request.
ReservationAuthorizationTests verifies that a spoofed ID cannot change the owner or audit actor. The test is included in the current C07 run.
F2 — missing automated evidence for overlapping reservations
ACCEPTED
ReservationCreationPersistenceTests against PostgreSQL rejects an occupied slot and overlapping interval while allowing adjacent intervals on both sides.
The 2 Nov 2026 C07 run passed all 37 backend tests against PostgreSQL; see C07 Verification Evidence.
F3 — secondary endpoint bypassed the reservation lifecycle when cancelling a slot
ACCEPTED
Both slot-cancellation endpoints use the authenticated actor and delegate the reservation transition to ReservationService, including authorization, cutoff, reason, history and notification.
ReservationAuthorizationTests covers spoofed-identity regressions and the owner's successful path; the complete suite passed in the current C07 run.
ACCEPTED; corrected in documentation/code
Baseline aligned; three-hour cutoff, create identity, test evidence, lifecycle ownership and quality-measurement scope clarified.
Details in frontend/src/features/docs/c06/C06_Assessment_consultation_reservation_system.md and docs/evidence-and-evolution.md.

blocks.content: Review argument: reservation and lifecycle requirements → verified identity and transition rules → `ReservationService` → persistence, history and notifications → test evidence and response to C06.

rows: 1. Scope and accepted behavior

REQ-01/BR-04: an authenticated student creates a reservation; PENDING and CONFIRMED block a slot; active student overlaps are rejected; intervals are [start,end). The slot must support the selected mode; creation has a 3-hour cutoff and a limit of 5 PENDING requests.
frontend/src/features/docs/c02/cs.json: OP-01, BR-01–04; ReservationService.create().
Demonstrate successful creation, an occupied slot, an overlap and an adjacent interval. Do not claim PENDING expiration is implemented.
2. Architecture
React → Spring Boot API → ReservationService → PostgreSQL. ReservationService owns the lifecycle, history and notifications; PostgreSQL protects active-slot exclusivity.
docs/architecture-and-decisions.md ADR-01; backend/src/main/java/consultation_reservation_backend/service/ReservationService.java; V1 migration.
Show the existing diagram against the source baseline and confirm the transaction boundary.
3. Detailed design
approve(): AuthenticatedUser + TEACHER role + ownership + PENDING → CONFIRMED, history and notification. cancel(): authorized student or slot owner, cutoff, reason, history and notification.
C05 DD; ReservationService.approve(), cancel(), cancelSlotWithReservation().
Demonstrate error paths 401/403/404/409 and a successful path; the concurrent approval regression now passes with row locking.
4. Verification
Creation persistence, authorization, approval persistence and cancellation persistence have corresponding automated test classes.

ReservationCreationPersistenceTests; ReservationAuthorizationTests; ReservationApprovalPersistenceTests; ReservationCancellationPersistenceTests. C07 Verification Evidence records 37 backend tests passed on 2 Nov 2026.
The full backend and frontend checks were rerun for the C07 working tree; see the evidence record and its commit limitation.
5. C06 engineering decision
F1–F3 accepted; implementation fixes preserve session identity and a single lifecycle owner.
C06 disposition, current ReservationService and regression tests.
Show the relevant code and rerun result. ACCEPTED alone is not evidence of a current run.
